info.description: The /api/v1 REST mirror of the 3ngram memory core (docs/concepts/architecture.mdx: one core, N transports). Authenticate with an X-API-Key header or a session Bearer token.
info.title: 3ngram REST API

delete.summary: Self-serve account deletion: erase PII in place and revoke credentials (GDPR Art. 17 erasure)

404.description: This tenant owns no session with that natural key

post.summary: Close an agent session by natural key (SessionEnd). Carries no activation_epoch and is idempotent — a repeat close echoes the first close timestamp.

404.description: This tenant owns no session with that natural key

post.summary: Refresh an agent session lease by natural key (Stop), resurrecting a closed or lease-expired row and optionally snapshotting the turn's bounded last assistant message.

includeUnscoped.description: Also match memories in the scope written with NO project (project IS NULL). Default false: strict scope AND project intersection.

409.description: A startup open reused a natural key already opened with different project, scope or selector

post.summary: Open or re-activate an agent session by its natural key (SessionStart). Idempotent: startup inserts, resume reuses the row and advances activation_epoch, and neither restamps the briefing.

404.description: This tenant owns no session with that natural key

post.summary: Ask whether a Stop should inject the debrief nudge for this run (natural key). The server evaluates the entry rule and the debounce and answers `armed`; a decline is a 200 carrying a content-free reason, and only an unknown natural key is a 404.

404.description: This tenant owns no session with that natural key

409.description: The attempt named is no longer the current one — a stale hook delivery, a second Stop, or a closer that re-claimed the row

post.summary: Finish a triage attempt: absorb whatever the continuation wrote and stamp the outcome — completed with provenance, expired on a zero-write continuation so the closer still runs, overflowed past the per-run ceiling — plus the cumulative event-id watermark.

400.description: Malformed run id, cursor or limit, or a run id this tenant does not own

get.summary: List the audit events one agent-session run produced (bounded, keyset-paginated). Each page is its own read-committed snapshot, so a write that commits after a page was read may be absent from that walk even if its id sorts earlier; treat one walk as a bounded observation, not the complete record of a run.

schema.description: Also match memories in the scope written with NO project (project IS NULL). Default false: strict scope AND project intersection.

Comma-separated subset of sections to compute (unique names from: commitments, overdue, blockers, staleCandidates, recentDecisions, preferences). Absent = all sections; un-requested sections are skipped and omitted from the result.
Per-section item bound (1..100). Absent = the mode default (3 brief / 25 full).

appliedScope.description: Scope your retrieval-scope policy applied to this unscoped call (mode default). Absent when nothing was narrowed.

schema.description: Inclusive lower bound on valid_from (valid-time window). Use at most 3 fractional-second digits (millisecond precision). Must not be later than `to` when both are given.
Exclusive upper bound on the valid-time window [from, to). Use at most 3 fractional-second digits (millisecond precision). Must not be earlier than `from` when both are given.

get.summary: Currently-valid facts, with optional bi-temporal time travel (mirrors the MCP get_facts tool)

schema.description: Single memory type to match. Mutually exclusive with memoryTypes — pass one or the other, never both.
OR-set of memory types to match (repeat the param to pass several). Mutually exclusive with type — pass one or the other, never both.
Inclusive lower bound on recorded_at. Use at most 3 fractional-second digits (millisecond precision). Must not be later than recordedBefore when both are given.
Inclusive upper bound on recorded_at. Use at most 3 fractional-second digits (millisecond precision). Must not be earlier than recordedAfter when both are given.

get.summary: List memories (bounded; identity fields only, never content)

validFrom.description: Inclusive START of the fact’s valid-time window, as an ISO-8601 instant. Use at most 3 fractional-second digits (millisecond precision) — a finer instant is rejected, never truncated. Omit (or null) to leave it unset.

validTo.description: Exclusive END of the fact’s valid-time window (requires validFrom), as an ISO-8601 instant. Use at most 3 fractional-second digits (millisecond precision) — a finer instant is rejected, never truncated. Omit (or null) to leave it unset.

sessionRunId.description: Opaque id of the current agent session run. Pass through from SessionStart. Omit to attach the single leased-open session for this project, if any. A run id not owned by this tenant fails the write.
